name: Marta Kostyuk
intro: Marta Kostyuk is a fierce player from Kyiv, Ukraine. She has been winning since she was a kid. This year she won the biggest trophy of her life in Madrid.
story: Marta comes from a tennis family. Her mom was a pro player and taught her the game. At 14 she won the junior Australian Open. This spring she won 12 clay matches in a row, ending in Madrid. On Friday she won in straight sets, so she plays again Sunday.

funFacts.text: After winning in Madrid, she did a backflip on the court!
Nadia Comaneci, a famous gymnast, gave the backflip a perfect 10.
She packs a sleep mask and lavender spray for her pillow.
On tournament nights she stays in, orders food, and watches Netflix.
She loves to try a new restaurant in each city.
Her mom, Talina, was a pro tennis player. Her uncle played for Ukraine too.
At 15 she played at the Australian Open. She was the youngest there in years.

watchFor: Spot her cool outfit, then stay to see if she does a backflip!
